remainingIntegrationGates: Root applies exact two paths and binds authenticated, closed routes with body limit >=512KiB+4KiB.
Root trusted parent dialog must show full preview, enforce page/nonce/epoch after every await, then explicit confirmation.
External confirmation only offers visible noopener/noreferrer link for a separate user click; never claim browser actually opened.
Handoff delivery token remains parent-only; SDK validates/deepfreezes draft-only envelope and target domain validates payload before explicit review/draft.
No live HTTP route, browser, native worker/domain or actual target navigation acceptance was performed by this staged task.
residualBoundaries: Host cannot cryptographically verify a physical user gesture; authorization relies on existing parent Host-token boundary and trusted confirmation UI.
Tickets are memory-only and intentionally invalidated on Host restart.
Generic payload is untrusted data, never authority; embedded fields cannot override envelope project or current target grant.
Target validity is checked synchronously at consume; target domain must independently validate its draft contract and never auto-execute.
